changelog.title: OpenMemo 1.8.0
changelog.description:
## [1.8.0] - 2026-05-18

- Full UI rebuild on token-driven design system with new fonts and icon set
- Collections page with stacked cards, memo counts, and drag-to-reorder
- Live Appearance panel for theme, accent, layout, and background customization
- New-memo glass capture panel with animated tabs for Link/Note/Media/Voice
- Command search overlay (⌘K) and fullscreen distraction-free writer
- First-run onboarding tour and Ask memo chat history with session management
- Storage stats endpoint showing disk usage breakdown by type
- Local thumbnail cache and dominant-color card backdrops
- Settings redesigned with bento grid masonry layout
- Maintenance endpoints for cache clearing and workspace reset
